title: Average days between consecutive invoices, per account
prompt: For accounts with at least 3 invoices, what's the average number of days between consecutive invoices?
population: Invoices, restricted at the end to accounts with at least 2 gaps between consecutive invoices (i.e., ≥3 invoices).
metricDefinition: average of date_diff('day', previous invoice's issued_at, this invoice's issued_at), per account, for accounts with ≥3 invoices.
referenceSql: WITH gaps AS (SELECT account_id, issued_at, date_diff('day', lag(issued_at) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY issued_at), issued_at) AS days_since_prev FROM invoices) SELECT account_id, avg(days_since_prev) AS avg_days_between_invoices FROM gaps WHERE days_since_prev IS NOT NULL GROUP BY account_id HAVING count(*) >= 2
